title: Maintain ledger end-to-end by creating, editing, and deleting a transaction
description: Verifies a user can create a transaction, see it in the list, edit it, and delete it so it no longer appears.

steps.description: Click the link to open the transactions page
Fill a valid date into the date field
Fill Ledger CRUD test into the description field
Select the newly created transaction from the list
Select the updated transaction from the list
Verify the transaction is no longer shown in the transactions list

title: Redirect unauthenticated user to sign-in when accessing transactions and return after sign-in
description: Verifies that an unauthenticated deep-link to transactions redirects to the sign-in flow and, after signing in, returns the user to transactions with data visible.

steps.description: Wait for the sign-in page to load
Verify the user lands on the transactions page
Verify a transactions list or empty-state is displayed

title: Create an organization and land on the dashboard in org context
description: Verifies an authenticated user can complete organization setup and then access the dashboard without broken organization state.

steps.description: Fill Acme Org into the organization name field
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify dashboard KPI or summary widgets are displayed

title: Show validation error for incorrect credentials and allow successful sign-in to dashboard
description: Verifies that invalid credentials show a validation error and that correcting credentials successfully signs in and lands on the dashboard.

steps.description: Wait for the sign-in page to load
Fill invalid credentials into the sign-in form fields
Wait for the sign-in form to finish processing
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify dashboard KPI content is displayed

title: Create a new transaction and have it appear in the ledger list
description: Verifies that submitting the new transaction form results in a new ledger entry appearing in the transactions list.

steps.description: Click the link to open the transactions page
Fill a valid date into the date field
Fill New transaction appears test into the description field
Verify a transaction matching the submitted description is displayed in the list

title: Delete a transaction and remove it from the ledger list
description: Verifies that deleting a transaction removes it from the transactions list after confirmation.

steps.description: Click the link to open the transactions page
Fill a valid date into the date field
Fill Delete me transaction into the description field
Select the transaction matching the submitted description from the list
Verify a transaction matching the submitted description is not displayed in the list

title: Edit a transaction and see the updated values reflected in the list
description: Verifies that editing an existing transaction updates it successfully and the updated content is visible in the transactions list.

steps.description: Click the link to open the transactions page
Fill a valid date into the date field
Fill Edit me transaction into the description field
Select the transaction matching the submitted description from the list
Verify the edited transaction shows the updated amount in the list

title: View reports for a selected period with comparison
description: Verifies a user can select a date range and comparison period on Reports and analytics and see charts and category breakdowns update accordingly.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view reports and analytics
Select a valid primary date range for the report
Verify report charts and category breakdowns are displayed for the selected period with comparison context visible

title: Render dashboard KPIs, trends, and recent activity for an authenticated user
description: Verifies that an authenticated user can view KPI cards, a trend visualization, and recent activity on the dashboard.

steps.description: Click the link to open the dashboard
Verify a trend visualization and recent activity are displayed

title: Create a budget and see it listed with utilization
description: Verifies a user can create a new budget with a limit and period and the budget appears in the budgets list with a utilization indicator.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to budgets
Open the create new budget flow
Fill Budget Alpha into the budget name field
Fill 500 into the budget limit field
Verify the new budget appears in the budgets list
Verify the budget shows a utilization indicator

title: Filter transactions by date range to narrow the ledger list
description: Verifies that applying a date range filter updates the transactions list to show only results for that range.

steps.description: Click the link to open the transactions page
Fill a valid date into the date field
Fill Filter target transaction into the description field
Set a date range filter that includes the created transaction date
Verify a transaction matching the submitted description is displayed in the filtered results

title: Edit an existing budget and see utilization reflect the update
description: Verifies a user can edit a budget’s limit or period and the budget card reflects the updated utilization state.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to budgets
Open the create new budget flow
Fill Budget Beta into the budget name field
Fill 200 into the budget limit field
Open the budget details for Budget Beta
Fill 400 into the budget limit field
Verify Budget Beta reflects the updated limit in its details
Verify the budget utilization indicator updates after the edit

title: Change report filters to update insights
description: Verifies adjusting available report filters updates the displayed report results without leaving the reports page.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view reports and analytics
Select a valid primary date range for the report
Adjust an available report filter (such as category or transaction type)
Verify the report results refresh to reflect the updated filters

title: Settings updates persist with confirmation
description: Verifies a user can update account or organization details in Settings and receives a success confirmation with the updated values still present.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view settings
Fill a new organization or account display name into the appropriate field
Verify a success confirmation is visible and the updated details remain shown in settings

title: Remove a budget and confirm it no longer appears
description: Verifies a user can remove a budget after confirming and it disappears from the budgets list.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to budgets
Open the create new budget flow
Fill Budget Gamma into the budget name field
Fill 300 into the budget limit field
Open the budget actions for Budget Gamma
Verify Budget Gamma is no longer shown in the budgets list
Verify the budgets list no longer includes the removed budget card

title: Category breakdown reflects selected period
description: Verifies the category breakdown section reflects the selected date range and remains consistent with the current report configuration.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view reports and analytics
Select a valid primary date range for the report
Verify a category breakdown is displayed for the selected period

title: Danger zone destructive action requires explicit confirmation
description: Verifies a destructive action in the Settings danger zone cannot proceed without explicit confirmation and only completes after confirming intent.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view settings
Scroll to the danger zone section
Verify no destructive state change has occurred and the user remains able to manage settings

title: Danger zone destructive action completes after confirmation and results in expected state change
description: Verifies confirming a danger zone destructive action completes and the app transitions into the resulting post-action state.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view settings
Scroll to the danger zone section
Confirm intent in the danger zone confirmation step
Verify a confirmation of completion is visible and the user is taken to a valid post-action state (such as org setup or a state requiring org selection)

title: Create a recurring transaction rule and see it listed
description: Verifies a user can create a recurring transaction rule with amount, cadence, and start date and it appears in the recurring list.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to recurring transactions
Open the add recurring transaction flow
Fill a valid start date into the start date field
Verify a new recurring rule appears in the recurring list
Verify the listed rule shows the selected cadence and amount

title: Reports empty-state handling for no matching data
description: Verifies the reports page shows an appropriate empty state when a valid date range yields no reportable data.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view reports and analytics
Select a valid date range that is unlikely to contain any transactions (far in the past or far in the future)
Verify an empty-state message is visible and no report charts are shown as populated

title: Invite a teammate and see the invitation listed as pending
description: Verifies an org admin can invite a teammate by email and the pending invitation appears in the team list.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to team management
Fill teammate1+pending@example.com into the teammate email field
Verify the team page shows a pending invitation entry
Verify the pending invitation includes the invited email address

title: Settings validation prevents saving invalid required fields
description: Verifies Settings blocks saving when a required field is cleared and shows a validation error without applying changes.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view settings
Clear a required account or organization details field
Verify a validation error is visible and changes are not saved

title: Budget creation requires mandatory fields
description: Verifies the budget form prevents submission when required fields are missing and shows a validation error.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to budgets
Open the create new budget flow
Fill Budget Missing Limit into the budget name field
Verify a form validation error is visible
Verify no new budget is added to the budgets list

title: Toggle comparison on and off in reports
description: Verifies the user can enable and disable comparison mode and the UI updates to show or hide comparison insights accordingly.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to view reports and analytics
Select a valid primary date range for the report
Disable comparison mode using the available control
Verify comparison-specific values are no longer displayed and only the primary period insights remain

title: Revoke a pending invitation or remove a member and see the list update
description: Verifies an org admin can revoke a pending invite or remove a member and the team list reflects the change.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to team management
Fill teammate2+revoke@example.com into the teammate email field
Initiate the revoke action for the pending invitation matching teammate2+revoke@example.com
Confirm the revoke or removal action
Verify the revoked invitation or removed member no longer appears in the team list
Verify the team list updates to reflect the access change

title: Edit a recurring rule and see the list update
description: Verifies a user can edit an existing recurring rule and the recurring list reflects the updated cadence or amount.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to recurring transactions
Open the add recurring transaction flow
Fill a valid start date into the start date field
Open the recurring rule details for the newly created entry
Open the edit recurring rule flow
Select a different valid cadence option
Verify the recurring rule list reflects the updated amount
Verify the recurring rule list reflects the updated cadence

title: Budget limit rejects zero or negative values
description: Verifies the budget limit input validates against zero or negative values and prevents creating the budget.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to budgets
Open the create new budget flow
Fill Budget Invalid Limit into the budget name field
Fill -10 into the budget limit field
Verify a numeric validation error is visible for the budget limit
Verify the budget is not created in the budgets list

title: Delete a recurring rule and confirm it is removed
description: Verifies a user can delete a recurring transaction rule after confirming and it disappears from the recurring list.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to recurring transactions
Open the add recurring transaction flow
Fill a valid start date into the start date field
Open the recurring rule actions for the newly created entry
Initiate the delete recurring rule action
Verify the recurring rule is no longer present in the recurring list
Verify the recurring list count decreases after deletion

title: Recurring rule requires a valid amount
description: Verifies the recurring transaction form validates the amount field and blocks submission when the amount is invalid.

steps.description: Click the navigation link to recurring transactions
Open the add recurring transaction flow
Fill a valid start date into the start date field
Verify a numeric validation error is visible for the amount
Verify no new recurring rule is added to the recurring list
